questions.stem: Why do plant cells still need mitochondria even though they have chloroplasts?

options.text: Chloroplasts can only work during the day, but cells need energy from respiration at all times
Mitochondria store starch that chloroplasts produce
Chloroplasts cannot function without mitochondria providing DNA

questions.explanation: Photosynthesis in chloroplasts only occurs when light is available, but cells need energy constantly. Mitochondria carry out aerobic respiration 24 hours a day to provide the ATP that cells need for their activities.
